role: XCUITest coverage of the Record tab: session-type selector visible, some pairing guidance with no strap, and scrolling without crash.

flags.text: Passes the bare '-UITests' launch argument, which no production code reads (only -UITests-FreshInstall at AppLaunchRecovery.swift:185 and -UITests-ForcePaywall/-UITests-SeedArchive at UITestLaunchArguments.swift:18,23 are checked); it is inert
Class doc says the Lost Sessions / Data Recovery entry is asserted reachable; testRecordPanelScrollsWithoutCrashing only swipes and checks the tab bar

units.does: Sets continueAfterFailure=false, creates XCUIApplication, appends launch arguments -UITests, -UITests-FreshInstall and English locale (UITestLanguage.english), launches the app (the app wipes onboarding/disclaimer/paywall flags, settings files and the session archive via AppLaunchRecovery.resetUITestStateIfRequested) and walks every first-run gate with UITestLaunch.toMainUI, ignoring its Bool result; then navigates to the Record tab.
units.entry: XCTest runner: setUp before each test in the class

units.does: Releases the XCUIApplication (app = nil); does not terminate the app.
units.entry: XCTest runner: tearDown after each test in the class

units.does: Asserts the tab bar exists, finds a tab-bar button whose label contains 'Record', asserts it exists, plain-taps it, and waits up to 6s for a scroll view.

flags.text: Hand-rolled label-only tab tap duplicating UITestNav.selectTab without hittability polling or content confirmation

units.does: Asserts any button or static text containing 'Extended' or 'Quick' appears.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Checks six substrings (Pair, device, Polar, Strap, Connect, Add) against static texts and buttons and asserts at least one matches.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

flags.text: Substrings like 'Add', 'device' and 'Connect' match ordinary copy anywhere on the screen (or in the tab bar's neighbours), so the assertion does not establish that pairing guidance is shown

units.does: If a scroll view appears within 6s, swipes it up 4 and down 4 times and asserts the tab bar exists; otherwise returns with no assertion.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

branches.effect: return silently (test passes with zero assertions)

flags.text: guard ... else { return } makes a missing Record scroll view a pass with no assertion
